crossRefs.note: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,
His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was…
She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to…

translations.web: The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
translations.bsb: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.
translations.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
translations.asv: The same dealt craftily with our race, and ill-treated our fathers, that they should cast out their babes to the end they might not live.
